description: This file defines a controller class `CriteriaSubController` within the Goteo project, specifically in the admin section. It manages CRUD operations and actions related to 'criteria' in the application, including translation, editing, adding, listing, and ordering criteria. The class enforces permissions, handles input, manages model interactions, and returns view data for rendering.

classes.name: CriteriaSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing criteria-related actions in the admin section, including permission checks, CRUD operations, and ordering of criteria.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access the criteria management functions based on node type and role.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the translation process for criteria, routing to the 'process' method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the editing process for a criterion.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new criterion.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a criterion up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a criterion down in order.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists criteria based on current filters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method handling CRUD operations, ordering, and processing user input for criteria management.
